verdict_text: NO. The sharding logic does not guarantee that `gpt_neox.embed_in.weight` and `embed_out.weight` are each stored alone; because each is about 206 MB—below the 512 MiB limit—the greedy packer may combine them with other tensors. This violates the explicit sharding clause requiring those tensors to occupy their own shards.
